name: TopGoal
rootCause: Hot wallets operated by TopGoal were attacked and compromised. In this hack, only the hot wallet operated by TopGoal, which manages the distribution of TopPrize rewards, was affected. All user assets including NFTs and TMTs are safe. The hackers transferred a total of 4,809,984 TMT from the TopGoal-operated hot wallet to the address 0x7F0D082D08874A57110c73a8853967e7C19D1a6e. The hackers then exchanged all those TMTs from PancakeSwap for over 2,600 BNB and used Tornado to transfer the BNB out of the address.

descriptions.text: Hot wallets operated by TopGoal were attacked and compromised. In this hack, only the hot wallet operated by TopGoal, which manages the distribution of TopPrize rewards, was affected. All user assets including NFTs and TMTs are safe. The hackers transferred a total of 4,809,984 TMT from the TopGoal-operated hot wallet to the address 0x7F0D082D08874A57110c73a8853967e7C19D1a6e. The hackers then exchanged all those TMTs from PancakeSwap for over 2,600 BNB and used Tornado to transfer the BNB out of the address.

On 16 February 2022, TopGoal's operational hot wallet on BNB Chain was compromised, allowing an attacker to transfer and liquidate nearly 4.81 million TMT tokens for BNB, then launder the proceeds through Tornado Cash. All stolen tokens belonged to the founding team and were not user assets. The incident was caused by a compromise of TopGoal's operational hot wallet private key, enabling unauthorized outbound transfers of TMT tokens.
